# Checkpoint — Tavis Ormandy / 社区参与与反馈回路

## 身份确认
- 目标：Tavis Ormandy，Google Project Zero 创始成员之一（2014-2025），2025.10 离开 Google 成为独立研究员。
- 域名：lock.cmpxchg8b.com。社交：x.com/taviso。GitHub：taviso。
- 同名歧义：无明显歧义（GitHub 3.2k followers，公开 CVE 记录）。

## 已核实一手来源（WebFetch 成功，URL 与 source.url 一致）
1. Full Disclosure 2010-06-10 Windows HCP — seclists.org/fulldisclosure/2010/Jun/205
   - 5 天披露；"releasing this information rapidly is in the best interest of security"；
   - "if I had reported the MPC::HexToNum() issue without a working exploit, I would have been ignored"；
   - "Without access to extremely smart colleagues, I would likely have given up" — 明确承认同侪协作是完成的必要条件；
   - "problems with bug secrecy (or in PR speak, 'responsible disclosure')"；"open collaboration with our peers"；
   - 致谢 lcamtuf 解决 deferred execution；引 Schneier 两篇。
2. oss-security XZ debate 2024-03-29/30 — openwall.com/lists/oss-security/2024/03/{29/16, 30/7}
   - "shouldn't this have been redirected to oss-security immediately from distros?"
   - "I think we should have a policy that if issues are suspected to be actively exploited, that the issue goes public immediately."
   - 对 Marc Deslauriers (Canonical)：'The attackers already knew about this issue, so you were just keeping it from defenders... that doesn't make sense to me.'
   - "making big decisions for a lot of people"；"more eyes on this"。
3. FireEye P0 2015-12-15 — projectzero.google/2015/12/fireeye-exploitation-project-zeros.html
   - 共同发现：Tavis Ormandy + Natalie Silvanovich；
   - "FireEye have been very cooperative... responded very quickly... within hours... resolved within 2 days"；
   - 署名 "Chief Silver Bullet Skeptic"；advisory #666。
4. Kaspersky P0 2015-09-22 — projectzero.google/2015/09/kaspersky-mo-unpackers-mo-problems.html
   - "record breaking response times... high bar to beat"；
   - "active black market trade in antivirus exploits exists" + WikiLeaks 价目表；
   - 建议 sandbox unpackers/emulators/parsers；"chromium sandbox is open source... add sandboxing to your development roadmap today"。
5. Zenbleed 2023-07 — lock.cmpxchg8b.com/zenbleed.html
   - 致谢 Eduardo Vela Nava、Alexandra Sandulescu（共同发现）、Josh Eads（分析）；
   - "I couldn't have found it without help from my colleagues"；
   - "I don't have an EE background!"；
   - 自创 "Oracle Serialization"；
   - 报告 AMD 2023-05-15。
6. Reptar 2023-11 — lock.cmpxchg8b.com/reptar.html
   - "Independently discovered by multiple research teams within Google, including the silifuzz team and Google Information Security Engineering"；
   - 命名贡献者：Ormandy, Eads, Vela Nava, Sandulescu, Moghimi；
   - "If you're interested in studying this, then we would love to get your input!" — 明确公开邀请社区输入；
   - "we don't have any way to debug μop execution!" + "we simply don't know... I suspect"；
   - Intel SA-00950。
7. Anubis 2025-08 — lock.cmpxchg8b.com/anubis.html
   - 发布前 email maintainer 未获回复："I didn't hear back"；
   - "I'm sympathetic to the cause"（语气校准：对小型 OSS 项目更温和）；
   - 发现 double-spend bug 并开 GitHub issue，maintainer "fixed just a few minutes after opening an issue"（PR #1003）— 即时社区反馈回路；
   - "I wrote this article with my own puny brain, I didn't use any AI"。

## 种子材料与一手核实的关系
- 02-conversations.md 列出 XZ debate 6 条 openwall URL（29/16, 29/25, 30/7, 30/23, 30/28, 30/29）；本次核实了 29/16 与 30/7，确认种子总结的引文准确（"keeping it from defenders"、"making big decisions"、"would love to get your input" 实际出自 Reptar 而非 Zenbleed — 种子 03-expression-dna 与 04-external-views 把这句归到 Reptar 是对的，02-conversations 没具体归属 URL，无误）。
- 种子 02 提到 "would love to get your input" 出现在 Reptar — 已核实（Reptar 文中确实有）。
- 种子 02 提到 Ormandy "Acknowledged having previously been on vendor-sec and distros lists himself" — 本次 29/16 与 30/7 均未抓到该自述；标记为 reported（种子转述），非 documented。
- 种子 02 称 "Most extensive recent public debate" 与 Marc Deslauriers — 已在 30/7 核实直接交锋。

## 仍未核实 / 资料缺口（gaps）
- EntrySign 2025-02-04 oss-security 帖（openwall.com/lists/oss-security/2025/02/04/1）：种子引 "the vendor has been really excruciating to deal with, this is the first time I've been allowed to see the patch!!" — 未本次抓取，列为 gap（仅 reported via 种子，非 documented）。
- 2024 oss-security libarchive RarVM、CUPS patch 帖：种子提到但未给 URL，未核实。
- GitHub issue/PR 层面的同伴互动（loadlibrary、ctypes.sh PR 评论）未抓取。
- Twitter/X @taviso 内容无法直接抓取（仅通过二手转述）。
- 2010 HCP 帖中 "extremely smart colleagues" 与 lcamtuf 已核实为同侪协作证据，但具体同伴姓名（除 lcamtuf）未抓全。
- Cloudbleed (2017) Cloudflare 反馈回路（21 分钟响应）— 仅种子+二手，未一手抓取 cloudflare blog。
